note.text: Manually authored FHIR R4 companion. CRL does not currently generate this artifact family. Descriptive source-linked context, not an executable eligibility rule, treatment order, or assertion of clinical validation.

Active/confirmed diagnosis, explicit cM0, record linkage and unknown handling are track-authored operational choices. ASCO recommendation 3.2 supplies the small cT1a/b N0 negative contrast. Clinical T/N categories are supplied, never inferred from size or pathological node counts.

definitionCodeableConcept.text: Adults undergoing pretreatment review of an active, confirmed invasive breast cancer, with explicit clinical M0; ER, PR and HER2 negative; and either clinical T1c/T2/T3/T4 or clinical N1/N2/N3. All tumor-specific observations refer to the indexed cancer. Missing or unresolved inputs remain unknown.
